description: Title 49 of the US Code of Federal Regulations, Part 195, regulates the transport of hazardous liquids and carbon dioxide by pipeline, under the Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA), and is published as a continuously updated electronic text (eCFR). Contents: subparts on general rules, annual, accident and safety-related condition reporting, design requirements, construction, pressure testing, operation and maintenance, qualification of pipeline personnel and corrosion control, among others. Section 195.3 lists the standards incorporated by reference, 45 items when read, from the American Petroleum Institute, ASME, the Pipeline Research Council International, the National Fire Protection Association and others. Coverage: hazardous liquid pipelines in the United States; the eCFR text was current to 25 September 2026, including April 2026 amendments. Format and access: HTML on eCFR and XML through the eCFR API. Licence and cost: free public law. Caveats: eCFR is an editorial compilation, not the official edition, and the referenced industry standards are sold separately. Its reporting thresholds, testing and maintenance rules help define failure and repair assumptions in hazard exposure and resilience models of oil and product pipelines. It relates to 49 CFR Part 192 and the PHMSA incident data in the catalogue.
